companies.additional_story_text: Retrospective historical research scenario using FY2026 reported parent earnings and March31 2026 consolidated common-book inputs, reviewed November3 2026. This is not a current quote-based valuation or a simulation of information available on March31. Parent denominator 15659052066 equals 15393368328 paid-up shares plus 233964038 outstanding options plus 31719700 units, all on the same historical capital basis. Assume full issuance without exercise proceeds; do not deduct a separate parent option value or subtract existing NCI again. Hold the reported subsidiary ownership/parent-income scope constant in the forecast. Subsidiary awards exist and future ownership dilution is not modeled; that is a forecast assumption, not a zero-claim fact. Nominal INR cost of equity15%, terminal ROE15%, book growth3% and10 relative years remain low-confidence User Assumptions, not company guidance. Reported parent book and earnings remain unchanged, including their accounting and nonrecurring-item limits. The selected book basis excludes separately presented award reserves; no new reserve deduction or reclassification is made, and an accounting reserve is not an award fair value. No market comparison is supplied. Parent-share issuance and aggregate-equity-haircut sensitivities show this scenario's dependence on omitted future dilution.
uncertainty: Reported FY2026 parent profit includes identified disposal and tax items; the model deliberately starts from reported profit and fades ROE, rather than claiming normalized recurring profit.
FY2024 pre-bonus per-share comparisons remain unsuitable without a separate adjustment.

Full issuance with no proceeds is conservative for the parent-share denominator conditional on fixed aggregate equity. It is not a proven lower bound on the economic value of the entire banking group.
Future subsidiary awards, capital requirements, payout constraints, new grants, repurchases and business changes are not forecast independently.
Do not add a parent option-value deduction, another NCI deduction, depositary-receipt shares or weighted EPS shares on top of this method.
Freshness and historical basis remain visible. Calendar forecast years and market comparison remain unavailable; use relative years.

reference_calculation.sensitivity_scope: Separate illustrative stresses, not probabilities or measured issuer dilution. Do not apply both mechanically as one claim.
